description: This file defines React functional components and related UI elements for implementing job filter controls in a job search or career navigation application. It includes dropdowns for filtering by job title, industry, skills, and salary range, as well as active filter tags with removal functionality.

methods.name: FilterDropdown
methods.description: A dropdown component for selecting an option from a list, used for job title and industry filters.

methods.name: SkillsDropdown
methods.description: A dropdown component for selecting multiple skills, with toggle functionality.
